subject: Venue AV specs and travel plan for June enterprise workshop
messages:
From: laura_bennett
To: Sophie Martin <sophie@cedarvenues.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Apr 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Venue capacity & AV needs — Redwood enterprise workshop (June 9-10)

Hi Sophie,

Quick intro — I'm coordinating Redwood's two-day enterprise workshop for one of our top mid-market customers (June 9-10). Expected headcount: 72 total (all on-site day 1, hybrid day 2 with ~35 remote). We're looking at your Level 2 configurable room for main session + two smaller breakout rooms.

Immediate asks so we can finalize travel:
- Can you confirm room capacities for theater and classroom setups (Level 2 main hall + two breakout rooms)?
- Do you have a PDF floorplan for Level 2 (doors, AV rack locations, service elevator dimensions)?
- AV needs: two camera angles for main session, presenter confidence monitor, wired stage mics (4), 6 tabletop mics for panels, HDMI/USB-C patching at stage, and a stable hub for a single Zoom call bridge. Is your in-house kit sufficient or do you require an external vendor?
- On-site tech: hourly rate and earliest setup/rehearsal window (we'd like a 3-hour tech check evening before for camera/shots and a 60-minute morning mic check).
- Internet: guaranteed wired bandwidth and number of reserved ports for streaming.

I'll loop in Marissa who owns the logistics. Attachments we expect back: floorplan + AV rider + pricing.

Thanks — we need the specs by next Wednesday (Apr 8) to confirm travel and freight.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Events & Customer Programs
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0182

From: Sophie Martin <sophie@cedarvenues.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Cedar & Co. Operations <ops@cedarvenues.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Venue capacity & AV needs — Redwood enterprise workshop (June 9-10)

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the details — excited to host Redwood. A few quick confirmations and an initial AV spec attached.

- Capacities (Level 2): main configurable hall — theater: 120 seated; classroom: 72 with 6’ tables (fits your 72 comfortably); breakout A: 24 classroom / 30 theater; breakout B: 18 classroom / 22 theater.
- Floorplan attached: cedar_level2_floorplan.pdf (shows door widths, service elevator: 36x54 in, loading bay hours: 7am-7pm).
- In-house AV: we cover cameras (2x PTZ HD), Dante audio network, wired stage mics, wireless lavs (limited to 6 concurrent channels). We provide a Zoom room bridge (we use a Cisco Webex/Zoom hybrid appliance) but for a dedicated RTMP/stream or complex SIP interop we recommend an external callbridge.
- Technician: Jesse Park is our senior AV tech. Rate: $95/hr (8-hour minimum for full event day). Rehearsal window yes — we can reserve 6-9pm on June 8 for camera blocking; morning check at 7:00am on June 9 is fine.
- Network: Dedicated 200 Mbps upstream reserved for your session; 8 wired Ethernet drops available in the hall (additional drops can be provisioned but require 48-hour lead).

Attachments included: AV_inventory_rider.docx (equipment list & patch plan), cedar_level2_floorplan.pdf, quote_line_items.pdf (separate doc). See the AV rider for exact camera models and HDMI/SDI patch locations.

Would you like us to coordinate onsite freight handling for crates and label requirements? If yes, please provide carrier contact and AWB.

Cheers,
Sophie Martin
Senior Events Manager
Cedar & Co. Venues
Sophie Martin <sophie@cedarvenues.com>
Phone: (415) 777-2200

Subject: Re: Venue capacity & AV needs — Redwood enterprise workshop (June 9-10)

Hi Sophie — thanks for the quick response and the attachments (reviewing AV rider now). A couple of operational confirmations before we sign off:

- Freight & receiving: Marco from TravelExec (cc'd) is our freight coordinator — can you confirm crate storage duration and whether there is a secure holding area? We expect 3 crates (camera + rigging + misc). Loading bay dims confirmed (thanks).
- Rigging/power: Are there overhead rigging points in the main hall? If not, can you provide rated floor stands? We need 2x 20A circuits on stage and one 100A distro for camera/truss (list in AV rider).
- Internet & VLANs: Is the 200 Mbps upstream a dedicated VLAN with QoS? We'll need static IPs for two stream encoders and 6 presenter laptops.
- Breakouts: For breakout A/B we'll need 2x HDMI patch points each + ability to route stage laptop to breakout via matrix (note this in the AV rider).
- Catering & arrival: catering will arrive 6:30am on June 9; vendor will require 30 mins for setup. Can catering access the loading bay directly?

Attachments: I'm attaching the travel_itineraries.xlsx (attendee flights + arrival windows) and highlight the dates when crates arrive (June 8, ETA 14:00). Please confirm a contact number for your loading dock and for Jesse (AV tech).

Marissa
Senior Events Ops
Redwood Inference

Subject: Final confirmation: Level 2 booking + AV tech + freight windows (June 8-10)

Hi Sophie (and team),

Thanks — this is great. Confirming the following so we can finalize PO and traveler itineraries:

1) Venue booking: Level 2 main hall + breakout A/B reserved June 8 (load-in)/June 9 (main day)/June 10 (wrap + strike).
2) AV tech: Please confirm Jesse Park as lead technician and provide mobile for day-of (we'll include in run-of-show). Tech confirmed at $95/hr, 8-hour minimum per day.
3) Freight: Marco will route three crates arriving June 8 at ~14:00 via FedEx Freight. Sophie — loading dock contact and secure holding area confirmation? Also confirm if we need insurance addendum for equipment held overnight.
4) Power & rigging: Please confirm the availability of two overhead points or provide rated stands. We requested 2x 20A circuits and a 100A distro.
5) Network: Please allocate two static IPs for encoders and 6 reserved ports. QoS required on the encoder VLAN for consistent upstream.
6) Rehearsal: June 8, 6-9pm reserved for camera blocking; June 9, 7:00-8:00am quick mic checks.

I've attached the attendee travel workbook and our preferred run-of-show template (in Drive link). Once Jesse and loading dock contact are confirmed we'll issue the PO and book flights/hotel for our core crew.

Thanks again — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Laura Bennett
Events & Customer Programs
Redwood Inference
